scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "blue,green"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/database && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
